/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
ns={'s':'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'}
for filename in ['logo.svg','mark.svg']:
 p=Path(filename);root=ET.parse(p).getroot()
 assert root.tag=='{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}svg'
 assert root.findall('.//s:path',ns)
 assert not root.findall('.//s:text',ns)
 assert not root.findall('.//s:image',ns)
 assert not root.findall('.//s:script',ns)
 print(filename, root.attrib['viewBox'], p.stat().st_size, 'bytes; valid standalone SVG with outlined artwork')
PY"
